metadata.title: Internex — The Future of Internship Discovery
metadata.description: A centralized platform bridging the gap between universities and enterprises. Skill-based matching, automated document generation, and placement tracking.

hero.headline: The Future of Internship Discovery
hero.description1: A centralized platform bridging the gap between universities and enterprises. Skill-based matching, automated document generation, and placement tracking—all in one elegant system.
hero.description2: Within the framework of MESRS strategy to strengthen the University-Enterprise link, Internex digitizes the entire internship lifecycle from discovery to official Convention de Stage.

howItWorks.label: How It Works
howItWorks.headline: Streamlined Workflow for Everyone
howItWorks.description: Whether you're a student seeking opportunities, a company looking for talent, or an administrator managing placements—Internex provides a seamless experience tailored to your role.
